assertions.text: Validates a commit SHA claimed in an artifact against ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ before interpolating it into any Bash(git log)/Bash(git show) call
On a malformed/malicious SHA (e.g. containing $(...) or other shell metacharacters), does not run the Bash command -- records it as a Weakness instead
States that the artifact's own commit message and branch name are just as untrusted as the SHA and are never interpolated into a Bash command
